name: @forge-dev/mod-qa
description: qa-pilot escalation inbox: pull requests that need a human, with the decision's gates, checks, findings and visual changes

actions.label: Get Evidence Image
actions.command: node -e "const out = require('child_process').execFileSync('gh', ['api', '-H', 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw', 'repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/' + process.env.FORGE_PARAM_PATH + '?ref=' + process.env.FORGE_PARAM_REF], { maxBuffer: 8e6 }); process.stdout.write(out.toString('base64'))"

actions.label: Week Stats
actions.command: gh pr list --state all --search "updated:>=$(node -e 'process.stdout.write(new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 864e5).toISOString().slice(0, 10))')" --json number,labels --limit 200

actions.label: Request Changes
actions.command:
gh pr comment "$FORGE_PARAM_PR" --body "$(printf 'Cambios pedidos desde Forge:

%s
' "$FORGE_PARAM_MSG")"

detectors.suggestion: qa-pilot contract found. Review escalated pull requests from QA.
